title: C6 approval-card provenance
head: 5e9f21a6cf004bb40973a07b82869622646553fa
brief: Chat-to-chat C6, display only. An approval card raised by a call from a turn that another chat's message started (a relayed turn, in the target chat), or that its reply started (a reply turn, in the sender), says which chat's message started the turn, under REQUESTED BY. Claims: no permission layer reads the provenance; a sub-agent's call in a relayed turn carries the line too; the chat title is reduced so it cannot forge or restyle the card; the HUD draws the line without changing buttons, focus or Tab order; nothing adds a path from a message to an approval.
focus: correctness, including under concurrency and across the ordering of events
handling of untrusted input, and safety-boundary changes
test coverage of the new behaviour: would the tests fail without the change?
claims in the description against the evidence in the diff and tests

ground_truth.mechanism: provenance follows the turn running when the card is raised, not the turn that spawned the sub-agent; a background child of a relayed turn that asks after the turn ends gets no line, and an owner turn's child asking during a later relayed turn gets a wrong line
ground_truth.evidence: relayed turn starts a background Agent and ends; the child then runs a dangerous command and the card shows no line. Conversely an owner-turn child asking during a later relayed turn names the other chat

ground_truth.mechanism: the decision-unchanged matrix compares only request.to_json(), so a label-driven change to a field not in to_json (max_wait_s) passes every suite
ground_truth.evidence: mutant: if request.relayed_from: request.max_wait_s = 1.0 in _ask passes both relay_provenance_checks and relay_provenance_check.py

ground_truth.mechanism: the line shows only the chat title, so two chats with the same model-written title are indistinguishable
ground_truth.evidence: no provider word or thread id is shown

ground_truth.mechanism: card_title lets Hangul fillers (U+3164, U+115F, U+1160, U+FFA0) and look-alike brackets and dots through, so a title can be blank or can imitate the card's own bracket and dot punctuation
ground_truth.evidence: 'x⟩ ⋅ your own turn ⟨y' is returned unchanged; a filler-only title renders blank

ground_truth.mechanism: title is not wrapped in <bdi> and a clipped title has no title attribute with the full line; status text in docs goes stale on merge
ground_truth.evidence: render the card with a right-to-left title: the title is a bare text child in Approvals.tsx with no <bdi> or unicode-bidi isolation, and a title clipped by the nowrap/ellipsis CSS has no title attribute; grep docs/notes/control-plane.md and the feature map for 'built on branch ... not merged', which is stale once the PR merges
